notes:
Inbound SMB lead focused on doc search / RAG. Lightweight, trial-first, wants hosted API (self-serve) but asks about scale options. Key details:
- Use-case: customer support KB + product docs -> user-facing answer bot + snippet reranking.
- Currently have ~5k uploaded sample docs in trial S3; expect to grow to 50k-200k in 6-12 months.
- Technical wants: embeddings for retrieval, similarity search, then reranking stage to improve answer relevance (candidate reranker or cross-encoder). Asking about recommended reranker models and whether Redwood supports a two-stage flow (open-source embedder -> vector DB -> lightweight reranker on hosted API).
- Latency/throughput targets: P50 end-to-end < 600-800ms for single-query; peak throughput modest (1-2k qps expected at launch). Cost sensitive: wants ballpark monthly cost given 50k docs and ~200k queries/mo.
- Integration questions: prefer minimal infra (hosted vector DB preferred), but open to connecting to Pinecone or Supabase. Also asks about incremental ingest pattern (S3 events -> batch embeddings) and idempotency.
- Security: needs SOC2, audit logs, optional SSO for admin UI; some EU customers so data residency discussion required later.
- Quotes from call: "We want something that just works out of the box — minimal infra to maintain." 
- Quote: "If the hosted embeddings + a simple reranker hits latency and cost targets, we'll likely stay with hosted plan and expand usage." 
- Proposed POC: 2-week trial using Redwood hosted embeddings + example reranker config; measure p50/p95 latency and cost per query.
- Risk: SMB budget constraints; may choose OpenAI + Pinecone if Redwood can't give clear cost/perf estimates for their workload.
